description: Source code for a minidump generator component in the Google Breakpad crash reporting system, including handle tracing and dump file creation.

classes.name: HandleTraceData
classes.description: Helper class for collecting handle operation data and formatting it into a minidump stream.

classes.name: MinidumpGenerator
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating minidump files, managing dump file creation, and handling dump data collection.

methods.name: WriteMinidump
methods.description: Writes the minidump file with collected crash data.

methods.name: GenerateDumpFile
methods.description: Creates a new dump file for crash data.

methods.name: GenerateFullDumpFile
methods.description: Creates a full memory dump file if requested.

methods.name: GetDbghelpModule
methods.description: Loads and returns the dbghelp.dll module.

methods.name: GetWriteDump
methods.description: Retrieves the address of the MiniDumpWriteDump function.

methods.name: GetRpcrt4Module
methods.description: Loads and returns the rpcrt4.dll module.

methods.name: GetCreateUuid
methods.description: Retrieves the address of the UuidCreate function.

methods.name: GenerateDumpFilePath
methods.description: Generates a unique file path for the dump file based on UUID.
